bullets.text: Agent 以 LLM 為核心，LLM 就像它的大腦。
bullets.quote: In a LLM-powered autonomous agent system, LLM functions as the agent’s brain, complemented by several key components:

bullets.text: 有些人把 agent 當成長時間獨立運作的完全自主系統。
bullets.quote: Some customers define agents as fully autonomous systems that operate independently over extended periods, using various tools to accomplish complex tasks.

bullets.text: Workflow 由程式先寫好路徑，agent 則由 LLM 自己決定下一步。
bullets.quote: Workflows are systems where LLMs and tools are orchestrated through predefined code paths.
